plain: Officials from the National Nuclear Security Administration, the US agency in charge of nuclear weapons, turned up at a gathering of the Sol Foundation, which Michels describes as a Stanford organisation devoted to UFO research. Michels says he was there and saw them show up. He brings it up as a sign that people from the nuclear side of government take an interest in the subject.
